methodological_anchor.name: dMAP / Fingerprinting Deep Packet Inspection Devices by Their Ambiguities, CCS 2025
methodological_anchor.key_rule: Fingerprint implementation behavior, not site-specific blocklists or policy.
methodological_anchor.validated_principle: A modest battery of roughly 20-40 discriminative ambiguity probes can separate DPI implementations even when their visible enforcement action is identical.

required_protei_dna_probe_families: IP fragmentation: ordering, overlap, duplicate fragments, reassembly preference, fragment limits
TCP parsing: checksum acceptance, sequence/ACK ambiguity, window semantics, malformed flags/options, retransmission handling
HTTP parsing: Host normalization, whitespace/case, duplicate headers, segmentation and request-line ambiguities
TLS parsing: ClientHello fragmentation, SNI placement/permutation, extension ordering, length ambiguities, TLS 1.2 vs 1.3
Statefulness: residual-state lifetime, tuple scope, timer reset/non-reset behavior
QUIC: v1/v2 parser behavior, Initial fragmentation, SNI coupling and state lifetime
Enforcement morphology: silent drop vs RST vs redirect, injected packet TTL/IPID/seq/ack/options/timing
Topology localization: determine whether observed behavior occurs inside the confirmed PROTEI customer ASN or at an upstream/transit censor

requirements: The same multi-probe behavioral vector appears in at least two independently confirmed PROTEI_DPI deployments.
The vector is stable across different blocked/test domains or policy configurations.
Matched non-PROTEI networks in the same country/event do not reproduce the vector.
Topology tests localize the behavior inside or immediately adjacent to the PROTEI deployment rather than a shared upstream.
No stronger alternative vendor fingerprint explains the observations.

current_findings.cuba_role: EXCLUDED_FROM_TRAINING_SET; use only after an independent PROTEI fingerprint is derived

next_priority: Recover raw or active ambiguity-probe measurements from AS50223, AS43197, AS37385, AS36939 or AS35568 where ethically and legally available.
Prefer pairs of deployments in different countries to avoid common national filtering infrastructure.
Compare against same-country non-PROTEI ASNs before assigning vendor identity.
Only after a PROTEI behavioral vector is independently established, search Cuba and the wider global corpus for that vector.
claim_ceiling: PUBLIC EVIDENCE NOW ESTABLISHES A MULTI-COUNTRY PROTEI_DPI REFERENCE SET, NOT A UNIQUE REMOTE PROTEI FINGERPRINT.
